channel.title: Wire — Releases
channel.description: Releases from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: WSO2 Releases Agent Manager as Enterprises Look to Control Growing AI Agent Sprawl
item.description: WSO2 has announced the general availability of WSO2 Agent Manager, an open-source platform designed to provide centralized governance, identity management, security controls, and operational oversight for AI agents running across different… (1 source: infoq)

item.title: htmx 4.0: a Fetch-Based Rewrite, Built-In Morphing Swaps, and Explicit Attribute Inheritance
item.description: htmx 4 has been released, featuring a transition from XMLHttpRequest to the fetch() API, enhancing streaming capabilities. Key updates include built-in morphing swaps for DOM state preservation and an hx-partial tag for cleaner updates. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: OpenAI Introduces Triage Framework and Case Studies to Report Model Misalignment
item.description: OpenAI has released a disclosure framework for model misalignment during its lifecycle. Employees can flag potential issues, prompting technical staff to label incidents. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Not In My Git Yard: Catching Backdoors at Commit and Release Time
item.description: Abstract page for arXiv paper 2607.26719: Not In My Git Yard: Catching Backdoors at Commit and Release Time (1 source: lobsters)

item.title: AWS Transfer Family now supports source IP preservation for SFTP servers behind a Network Load Balancer (NLB)
item.description: AWS Transfer Family now preserves the client's source IP address using Proxy Protocol v2 (PPv2) when you place a Network Load Balancer (NLB) in front of your SFTP server that uses a VPC-hosted endpoint. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS HealthOmics now supports IAM session policies
item.description: AWS HealthOmics now supports IAM session policies, enabling you to restrict permissions for individual runs without creating and managing multiple IAM roles. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS Batch now supports bulk job cancellation and termination
item.description: AWS Batch now supports bulk job cancellation and termination, enabling you to cancel or terminate up to 50 jobs with a single API call. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Introducing Amazon EC2 T8i instances
item.description: AWS is announcing the general availability of new low-cost burstable Amazon EC2 T8i instances. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS Elastic Beanstalk introduces Cluster Mode to run multiple applications on shared infrastructure
item.description: AWS Elastic Beanstalk introduces Cluster Mode, a new deployment mode that lets you run and manage multiple applications on shared infrastructure in your account. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon S3 Express One Zone is now available in 7 additional AWS Regions

item.title: jemalloc 5.4.0 release
item.description: Contribute to jemalloc/jemalloc development by creating an account on GitHub. (1 source: lobsters)
